description: Verkehrsberuhigte Zonen: Tempo 30 - Zone is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Mobilität. Dieser Datensatz beinhaltet die signalisierten Fussgängerzonen. Die verkehrsberuhigten Zonen setzen sich aus Fussgängerzonen, Begegnungszonen und Tempo 30-Zonen zusammen. Ebenso ist der Perimeter des Verkehrskonzepts Innenstadt mit der Kernzone mit eingeschränktem Motorfahrzeugverkehr dargestellt. Weitere Daten zu "Verkehrsberuhigte Zonen":. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Geography, Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Geschwindigkeitsbeschränkun, Fussgänger, Fussgängerzonen. The portal shows 190 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
